config.initialization: Only encoder and Train normalization are inherited from C1 epoch8. All public TabM parameters are random common clones; cardinality readouts and interaction outputs are zero initialized. P1/P2 share exactly the same added parameters. No old public classifier or optimizer is loaded.
config.training: Same online Train views, losses, seed13, dropout and update budget for three arms. Full encoder and public TabM co-adaptation. Minimum20 maximum40 epochs, joint patience10. Identical epoch0 is eligible.
config.selection: 0.5 original Val mean(Single,Double,background) + 0.5 mean of that score over five noisy conditions; tie original overall ACC. One trained checkpoint per arm; Test only after selection is sealed.
config.prediction: All arms have the same seven-set output plus late cardinality residual, average member probabilities. P0 no interaction, P1 shared cross-view interaction, P2 member input-adapted interaction. No true count or SNR is supplied to inference.
